description: Delete a tag. By default the deletion is refused if the tag is in use by transactions or rules: the result is an error containing a `dependents` payload listing the rules and transactions that still reference the tag. Set force=true to delete the tag and disassociate it from those records (irreversible).

force.description: If true, force deletion even if dependencies exist (irreversible). Defaults to false.

tagId.description: Id of the tag to delete.

name: delete_tag
